overview_description.description: FFbots is a Dubai-based robotics and defense technology company specializing in the development of remotely operated firefighting and rescue robots. Founded in 2021, the company focuses on enhancing firefighter safety and improving emergency response efficiency through autonomous and AI-enabled robotic systems. FFbots designs, manufactures, and assembles its robots locally in the UAE, supporting the region’s vision for advanced industrial and defense technologies. The company’s robotic solutions are built for hazardous environments such as industrial fires, oil and gas facilities, chemical plants, warehouses, tunnels, and civil defense operations. Its product lineup includes the Wabel firefighting robots, FW8000 high-capacity fire suppression robot, and IRON-500 rescue robot, all designed to operate remotely in dangerous conditions while carrying firefighting equipment, extinguishing agents, cameras, and thermal monitoring systems
